title: Fervent Manipulations
subtitle: Flammeus - blood remembers burning
text: The Fervent temper belongs to blood that has absorbed the violence of fire: things that burn, things that are burned. Sanguine Ignition (QUICK) scorches every body within five blocks and sets it alight. Scalding Updraft (QUICK) superheats the air under your feet and launches you; Soaring Updraft (QUICK) carries you higher and further, Suspended Updraft (QUICK) holds you in a brief pause before you float down, and Expulsive Updraft (QUICK) bursts outward and throws enemies aside. Cauterizing Rebuke (QUICK) burns poison, wither, necrosis and blood loss out of you, then flares at enemies close by. Vitric Combustion (CHARGED) detonates superheated blood and spends Searing for more. Phoenix Debt (PASSIVE) pays blood to survive a lethal blow in cleansing flame. Pyretic Forge (QUICK) smelts what you hold on R. Sculpting, Projection: held on items lying on the ground it smelts them where they lie, and on sand, stone, clay or a raw ore block it fires the block in place. Crimson Flame Conjuration (QUICK) sets crimson flame on R. Sculpting, Projection: held near unlit campfires and candles it kindles them, and on bare ground it paints a line of flame where you look; a click flares the whole line. Searing Lash (QUICK) cracks a boiling whip on R, and held it puts out a boiling lash. Furnace Veins (CONTINUOUS) channels a close heat field on R. Sculpting, Projection: held on a furnace, your blood burns as its fuel and the fuel of every furnace beside it. Conjure Torch reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Torch.
